source.verse_hash_method: SHA-256 of exact tab-separated Greek payload, retaining whitespace and variant markers.

key_decisions.rationale: Preserves welcome and prohibits adjudicating disputed thoughts.
key_decisions.before: Welcome the one who is weak in trust, but not for quarrels over opinions.
key_decisions.after: Welcome the one who is weak in faith, but not for the purpose of quarreling over opinions.
key_decisions.tsw_comparator: Now receive the one who is weak in faith, but not for disputes about opinions.

key_decisions.rationale: Keeps the differing day judgments and individual conviction.
key_decisions.before: One person judges one day to be above another; another judges every day alike. Let each person be fully convinced in their own mind.
key_decisions.after: One person judges one day to be more important than another, while another judges every day alike. Each person should be fully convinced in his own mind.
key_decisions.tsw_comparator: One judges one day above another, another judges every day alike. Let each one be fully convinced in his own mind.

key_decisions.rationale: Follows the pinned verbs died and lived and preserves lordship over both groups.
key_decisions.before: For this is why Christ died and lived again: so that he might be Lord of both the dead and the living.
key_decisions.after: For this reason Christ died and lived again, so that he might be Lord of both the dead and the living.
key_decisions.tsw_comparator: For to this end Christ died and lived again, that he might be Lord both of the dead and of the living.

key_decisions.rationale: Keeps both reciprocal questions and the pinned reading God's tribunal.
key_decisions.before: But you—why do you judge your brother or sister? And you—why do you despise your brother or sister? For we will all stand before God’s judgment seat.
key_decisions.after: But why do you judge your brother or sister? Or why do you despise your brother or sister? For we will all stand before God's judgment seat.
key_decisions.tsw_comparator: But you, why do you judge your brother? Or you again, why do you despise your brother? For we will all stand before the judgment seat of God.

key_decisions.rationale: Keeps Paul's conviction and conscience-relative consequence.
key_decisions.before: I know and am convinced in the Lord Jesus that nothing is unclean in itself. But if someone considers something unclean, then for that person it is unclean.
key_decisions.after: I know and am convinced in the Lord Jesus that nothing is unclean in itself. But if someone considers something unclean, then for that person it is unclean.
key_decisions.tsw_comparator: I know and am persuaded in the Lord Jesus that nothing is unclean in itself; but to the one who considers something to be unclean, to that one it is unclean.

key_decisions.rationale: Preserves service to Christ and the two audiences' approval.
key_decisions.before: Whoever serves Christ in this way is pleasing to God and approved by people.
key_decisions.after: For the one who serves Christ in this way is pleasing to God and approved by people.
key_decisions.tsw_comparator: For the one who serves Christ in this way is acceptable to God and approved by men.

key_decisions.rationale: Retains meat, wine, and all three variant-marked harms in the pinned source.
key_decisions.before: It is good not to eat meat or drink wine or do anything by which your brother or sister stumbles.
key_decisions.after: It is good not to eat meat or drink wine or do anything that causes your brother or sister to stumble, be ensnared, or become weak.
key_decisions.tsw_comparator: It is good not to eat meat or drink wine or do anything by which your brother stumbles.

key_decisions.rationale: Keeps private conviction before God and self-judgment warning.
key_decisions.before: The trust you have, keep it between yourself and God. Blessed is the one who does not condemn themselves by what they approve.
key_decisions.after: The faith you have, keep between yourself and God. Blessed is the one who does not condemn oneself by what one approves.
key_decisions.tsw_comparator: The faith that you have, have it to yourself before God. Blessed is the one who does not judge himself in what he approves.
